items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we just hung out there all the time... we liked the same music... when he went with Ornette east, I came later with Paul Bley. And Charlie heard A Genuine Tong Funeral and called me... I made arrangements of them.

ctx.x: Not that I know of. Yeah, when Dave Pike was in the band of course they did. Yeah they played two or three of my tunes. But when Steve fired Dave Pike and hired Ornette and Don, I think, Bill Higgins and Charlie were already in Paul’s band. They didn’t play my music anymore, because they played Ornette’s music. That was the point of hiring Ornette, to be able to play that, and I just really enjoyed, putting it lightly, I just was, felt like I was... I had a religious experience and now I was saved, ya know. It…
